summary: Route balancing / penalty terms are best-effort and never override hard constraints (C1–C7); infeasible tasks stay unassigned regardless of balancing configuration.
rule: Balancing and penalty terms under options.objective (e.g. minimize_visits_over_threshold) and options.constraint (vehicle_overtime_penalty, visit_lateness_penalty, max_vehicle_overtime as a soft constraint) are best-effort and subordinate to all hard constraints (C1–C7: capacity, time windows, precedence, max-stops, max-duration, skills, zones, depots). A task infeasible under hard constraints stays unassigned in result.unassigned regardless of balancing weights. Enabling balancing must never cause an otherwise-feasible task to become unassigned; it only shifts the order of feasible assignments.
testingGuidance: Positive: all jobs feasible under hard constraints + balancing options enabled -> all jobs still assigned (assert assignment count only, never the specific route distribution).
Negative-infeasible: a job infeasible under a hard constraint (e.g. impossible time window) stays unassigned regardless of balancing weights (assert unassigned reason).
